description.short: Fine, needle-rolled green tea from northern China with a fresh chestnut and vegetal flavor
description.overview: One of the premier green teas of northern China — representing the northernmost major commercial tea-growing region where climatic limits permit high-quality tea cultivation.
description.leaf: Fine, tightly rolled needle-shaped leaves dusted with tender white fuzz
description.liquor: Pale green, bright and clear liquor
description.aroma: Fresh, grassy, with toasted chestnut notes
description.taste: Vibrant and fresh, slightly brisk upfront, opening into a sweet roasted chestnut finish
description.processing: Plucking of one bud with one leaf → wok fixation → rolling into fine needles by hand or semi-mechanically → multi-stage low-temperature drying

history.origin: The name translates to 'Xinyang Fur Tips' — this region is historically considered the northern cradle of Chinese tea culture, documented since the Tang dynasty
history.development: Honored as one of China's Ten Famous Teas thanks to Henan's cooler climate, which promotes slower bud development and dense nutrient accumulation
history.modern: Because of its northerly latitude, the growing season is significantly shorter, imparting an extraordinary depth and concentration of flavor to the tea
interestingFacts: Henan is one of China's northernmost commercial tea-growing regions, contrasting with the predominantly southern distribution of tea cultivation in China
Traditional shaping required tea artisans to roll needles directly against heated metal trays with bare hands, demanding immense skill and heat tolerance
